intent: Create a physically coherent, text-free professional CG fashion-film frame on a rain-soaked elevated walkway: one model is caught mid-turn while translucent technical fabric visibly lags through inertia, and one distant train carries a single consistent left-to-right motion direction. The frame must read as unfolding action, not a standing poster.

creative_routing.audience_effect: feel the exact instant of directional change through body weight, fabric drag, rain, and the passing train
creative_routing.delivery_context: independent professional CG fashion motion test
creative_routing.design_priority: action readability, translucent-fabric behavior, wet-material separation, and layered depth
creative_routing.cultural_context: contemporary unbranded technical fashion without invented symbols or copy
creative_routing.mix_rule: luxury editorial controls garment hierarchy and restraint; documentary observation controls the non-heroic camera position and partial environmental occlusion
creative_routing.adaptation_rule: preserve physical motion, restrained color, and material truth over promotional posing

direction.genre: contemporary fashion motion film rendered as photoreal CG
direction.world_rule: rain, gravity, foot contact, garment inertia, train motion, reflections, and indirect light remain physically causal
direction.visual_goal: place the viewer beside the moving model at the turning instant, with garment lag and train direction readable before styling detail

cinematic.visible_event: the model abruptly changes direction while the outer translucent garment continues along the prior path for one beat
cinematic.relationship_pressure: the model's grounded body turn opposes the garment's inertial drag while the distant train continues left-to-right
cinematic.viewer_task: read the planted foot, torso rotation, trailing fabric, rain response, and one-way train motion as the same captured instant
cinematic.viewer_position: under the walkway canopy, just behind a foreground guardrail at waist height and offset from the model's path
cinematic.frozen_moment: the leading foot has planted and the torso has rotated, but the translucent coat panel is still sweeping behind
cinematic.withheld_information: the model's destination and the train's origin remain offscreen

scene.summary: rainy night on an elevated pedestrian walkway running parallel to an urban rail line
scene.setting: utilitarian covered high walkway with wet textured deck, restrained metal guardrails, structural columns, and one distant passing train
atmosphere: fine directional rain near practical light

subjects.description: one contemporary fashion model wearing an unbranded graphite base outfit and a translucent technical outer layer
subjects.action: rapidly changes direction mid-stride; the planted leading foot grips the wet deck while the torso and head have begun the turn
subjects.pose: asymmetric active turn with bent supporting knee, rotated torso, one arm following balance, and no front-facing fashion stance
subjects.gaze: looks into the new direction of travel rather than at the camera
subjects.scale: full body readable with the environment occupying more than half the frame
relationships: translucent outer fabric remains attached at shoulders and waist while its free panels lag behind the turn
the planted shoe makes visible contact with the wet deck
the train remains behind the model on a separate parallel track

staging.primary_relationship: body rotation changes direction while garment inertia briefly preserves the prior direction
subject_positions: passing train in the distant right-to-left-spanning background
wet guardrail edge in the lower foreground
staging.eyeline_logic: model looks toward the new offscreen path, never at the viewer
staging.screen_direction: train and every train-related blur move only from left to right
staging.axis: walkway and rail line remain parallel and spatially readable
staging.occlusion: a restrained foreground rail edge partially frames the lower body without hiding foot contact
staging.attention_path: planted shoe contact -> torso rotation -> translucent fabric arc -> left-to-right train streak -> open offscreen destination

spatial_dynamics.dominant_read: the model's sudden turn pulls against the translucent garment's delayed sweep
spatial_dynamics.secondary_read: the distant train carries one clean left-to-right vector through the rainy background
spatial_dynamics.beauty_mechanism: a clear turning silhouette against one quiet dark structural bay, with fabric transmission separated from matte skin and wet deck
spatial_dynamics.tension_source: grounded foot friction and body rotation oppose the fabric's inertia and rain drag
spatial_dynamics.realism_anchor: anatomically credible body weight, planted-foot compression, garment attachment points, gravity, wet contact, and parallel track geometry
spatial_dynamics.action_vector: model rotates into a new offscreen direction while the free fabric arcs through the previous direction
spatial_dynamics.counterforce: shoe friction, body mass, garment attachment, gravity, and rain resistance
spatial_dynamics.foreground_role: wet rail edge and close rain prove viewer position and parallax
spatial_dynamics.midground_role: model, planted foot, torso rotation, and translucent fabric own the action
spatial_dynamics.background_role: train and repeated walkway columns prove one-way speed, depth, and urban scale
spatial_dynamics.depth_transition: foreground wet rail leads to shoe contact, rises through the turning body and fabric arc, then releases into the train direction
spatial_dynamics.parallax_logic: near rail and model remain comparatively crisp while the farther train translates consistently left-to-right
motion_evidence: fabric lag from fixed attachment points
spatial_dynamics.readability_guard: keep face, hands, limbs, planted foot, garment attachment, and train geometry coherent; motion blur belongs only to trailing fabric edges, train, and fine rain

composition.perspective: moderately wide natural perspective with strong depth but no body stretching
composition.camera_motivation: the viewer stands under the same canopy behind a foreground rail, close enough to read foot contact and fabric inertia while the parallel train remains visible
composition.camera_height: approximately waist height at 1.1 meters, aligned with the body's center of rotation
composition.camera_distance: about five meters from the model so the full body, fabric arc, walkway geography, and train can coexist
composition.lens_rationale: 40mm preserves credible human proportions while retaining enough environmental depth and lateral train movement
composition.framing: one model occupies less than half the frame; walkway rails and columns create depth; train remains distant and lateral
composition.negative_space: one calm dark structural bay behind the turning silhouette and open space ahead of the new gaze direction
composition.camera_pitch: nearly level with a slight downward view to retain shoe contact
composition.camera_yaw: three-quarter across the walkway toward the parallel track
composition.perspective_distortion: restrained near-far separation without limb stretch
composition.edge_behavior: rail edges remain straight; face and limbs stay away from stretched corners
composition.crop_pressure: all limbs, planted foot, and main fabric arc remain inside frame; distant train may continue off both horizontal edges
composition.camera_state: brief tracking hold captured at the turn
composition.action_readability: full body, planted foot, torso rotation, fabric lag, and train vector readable at thumbnail size
depth_layers: wet rail edge and near rain

lighting.summary: physically motivated rain-night lighting from broad cool-white canopy panels and soft warm-neutral train windows
lighting.motivation: the walkway's broad canopy panels are the primary real source; wet deck bounce and distant train windows provide physically plausible secondary light
lighting.narrative_function: reveal the fabric's delayed translucent sweep, grounded shoe contact, and wet material separation while leaving one dark bay quiet
lighting.key: one broad overhead canopy panel shapes the model and reveals the translucent garment without creating a decorative rim
lighting.fill: multi-bounce cool-gray indirect light from wet deck and metal structure keeps shadow detail readable
lighting.rim: only source-consistent edge light where the wet translucent fabric crosses the canopy panel
lighting.direction: top-side canopy light with low background train-window contribution
lighting.contrast: medium-high night contrast with an open shadow floor
lighting.color_temperature: cool neutral main light; small warm-neutral train windows only

color_pipeline.color_science: scene-referred wide-gamut intent with hue-preserving highlight compression
color_pipeline.exposure_strategy: protect wet specular texture and translucent fabric while keeping face, hands, and shoe contact readable
color_pipeline.tonal_curve: medium-density midtones, deep but open graphite blacks, soft highlight shoulder
color_pipeline.black_point: dense neutral black without crushing garment folds or rail separation
color_pipeline.white_point: canopy panels may approach white while skin, fabric, train windows, and wet deck retain texture
color_pipeline.highlight_rolloff: long natural rolloff on rain, skin, polymer fabric, metal, and wet concrete
color_pipeline.shadow_floor: cool-neutral readable floor without cyan contamination
color_pipeline.midtone_density: firm enough to separate translucent garment from dark structure
color_pipeline.white_balance: cool-neutral canopy illumination with a small warm-neutral train-window accent
color_pipeline.color_separation: skin, graphite fabric, clear polymer, wet concrete, painted metal, and train windows remain distinct
color_pipeline.highlight_bias: neutral white with a restrained warm train accent
color_pipeline.skin_tone_policy: natural hue and luminance; rain beads stay localized rather than oily
color_pipeline.saturation_policy: restrained globally; no saturated neon color
color_pipeline.gamut_policy: compress train-window and canopy peaks without hue skews

film_emulation.grain: none beyond subtle physically plausible render texture
film_emulation.bloom: minimal and only at sufficiently bright canopy or train windows

color_pipeline.shot_matching: single-frame test; lock neutral black floor and restrained saturation

render_pipeline.lighting_transport: physically based direct light plus dynamic diffuse and indirect specular transport
render_pipeline.global_illumination: Lumen-like multi-bounce diffuse interreflection from broad canopy panels, wet deck, rails, and train windows
render_pipeline.ray_tracing: roughness-aware reflections with stable wet-surface response and no screen-space disappearance
render_pipeline.reflection_model: material-specific reflection width; puddles are sharper than damp concrete and dry-painted metal
render_pipeline.shadow_model: soft canopy shadows plus precise shoe, garment, rail, and clip-like contact visibility
render_pipeline.ambient_occlusion: local only at real shoe/deck, garment/body, rail/deck, and structural contacts
render_pipeline.volumetrics: clear rainy air; only fine rain becomes visible near named practical lights
render_pipeline.material_workflow: principled metallic-roughness PBR with thin translucent textile treatment
render_pipeline.transmission_refraction: thin technical fabric transmits and scatters light without becoming glass or glowing plastic
render_pipeline.displacement_normal: scale-correct concrete texture, fabric weave, and fine wetness normals only where camera-readable
render_pipeline.texture_scale: microtexture scale follows camera distance; strongest detail stays on face, fabric, planted shoe, and wet contact zone
render_pipeline.sampling_denoise: stable detail-preserving render with clean rain and fabric edges, no temporal shimmer or smeared hair
render_pipeline.performance_fidelity_tradeoff: final still prioritizes material and motion fidelity while retaining plausible real-time cinematic behavior

materials.description: thin layered technical textile with visible attachment points, wet weight, fabric drag, and selective transparency
materials.microstructure: fine woven or ripstop structure visible only on focal folds
materials.roughness: mostly matte-damp with narrower highlights only on saturated wet ridges
materials.specular_response: soft localized wet highlights rather than global plastic gloss
materials.transmission: background structure remains partially visible through one fabric layer and less visible through overlaps
materials.wear_patina: clean contemporary garment with no invented branding
materials.contact_deformation: fabric compresses at shoulders, waist, and arm contact; free panels lag behind the turn

materials.description: natural skin planes and rain-darkened hair under cool canopy light
materials.microstructure: subtle pores only at readable scale
materials.roughness: matte base with soft localized water highlights
materials.specular_response: controlled facial highlights, never oily or waxy
materials.contact_deformation: credible facial, hand, knee, and shoe anatomy during motion

materials.target: wet walkway deck, rails, and train
materials.description: wet textured deck with strict wet/dry boundaries, painted metal rails, and a distant moving train
materials.microstructure: deck texture stays scale-correct and directional water trails follow gravity and traffic
materials.roughness: puddles low, damp deck medium, dry sheltered bands high, painted rails medium-high
materials.specular_response: broad canopy reflections break according to wetness; train windows remain soft and distant
materials.wear_patina: subtle plausible walkway wear only at traffic and contact zones
materials.contact_deformation: shoe sole compresses against the wet deck with a readable contact shadow

optics.depth_of_field: moderate depth separation; model and shoe contact sharp, distant train slightly softer but direction readable
optics.focus_target: turning model from face through torso to planted foot and garment attachment
optics.motion_blur: directional only on trailing fabric edges, fine rain, and left-to-right train; face, hands, limbs, and planted foot remain coherent
optics.lens_character: clean 40mm rectilinear cinematic lens with restrained edge falloff
artifacts: minimal source-motivated bloom only at bright canopy or train-window edges

style.medium: professional photoreal CG fashion-film frame; Unreal Engine 5 is an appearance reference only, not a claim of actual engine execution
style.realism: physically plausible body, cloth, rain, material transport, contact, and camera behavior

must_preserve: exactly one model in an active rapid turn, not a standing pose
translucent technical fabric remains physically attached and visibly lags behind the body rotation
one distant train and every train-related motion cue move consistently from left to right
credible planted-foot contact, body weight, rain response, and material-specific wetness
foreground rail/rain, midground model, and background train each have a distinct depth role
restrained graphite and slate palette with only a small warm-neutral train-window accent
absence of text, logos, HUD, game interface, watermark, random neon, and decorative particles
exclude: random neon signs or saturated cyberpunk color
multiple trains or conflicting train directions
floating fabric detached from the body
uniform wet gloss across all materials
text, labels, logos, branding, or watermark

quality_controls: face, hands, limbs, planted foot, and fabric attachment remain anatomically and mechanically coherent
skin stays matte-natural while textile, metal, concrete, and water retain distinct roughness
motion blur stays directional and local; the frame retains one quiet dark structural bay
